correctness.rationale: Rebuilt all Fano incidence edges and cycle enumeration; Abrams unordered cubical C_0,C_1,C_2 counts 91,252,168; the signed boundary B times the 42 torus matrix T is exactly zero. Exact mod-three elimination gives rank B=154, while a specified 14x14 minor of T has determinant +1; therefore these torus cycles equal the full primitive rank-14 integral kernel of B. For local relation matrix R (42x28), exact TR=0, an explicit maximal minor equals -2, and rank R modulo two is 27, giving local index exactly 2 in saturated kernel. Every torus coordinate occurs in exactly two local relations; the half sum is integral, has 22 unit terms, is not locally integral, and completes the kernel. Exact 336-automorphism enumeration yields one orbit. The standalone program recreates all evidence from named graph incidence; no infinite extrapolation.

value.rationale: Complete structural classification of the relation lattice of all canonically indexed minimal disjoint-cycle product tori for a classical nonplanar graph; one orbit of 42 geometry-defined generators yields 28 local 3-term relations, but an index-two obstruction forces an essential 22-term global relation. This identifies integral information not determined by Betti numbers, a selected basis, or the Coxeter disjointness table and is motivated by the published degree-two graph-braid relation problem. Finite graph specificity and no universal extension are explicitly stated.
